description: This file defines API endpoints and handlers for file operations in the Focalboard server, including file upload, retrieval, and metadata access, with route registration and permission checks.

classes.name: FileUploadResponse
classes.description: Response model for file upload containing the file ID.

methods.name: FileUploadResponseFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a FileUploadResponse object.

methods.name: FileInfoResponseFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a mmModel.FileInfo object.

methods.name: registerFilesRoutes
methods.description: Registers API routes for file operations.

methods.name: handleServeFile
methods.description: Handles serving a file to the client, with permission checks and fallback for channel-based files.

methods.name: writeFileResponse
methods.description: Prepares and writes the file content response with appropriate headers.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata for a specified file.

methods.name: handleUploadFile
methods.description: Handles uploading a new file, with permission checks and size limits.
